Test results, scores, and study statistics;

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy and Personal Data Processing Agreement
privacyPage.p1: This Privacy Policy (hereinafter 'Policy') is developed in accordance with the Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan No. ZRU-547 'On Personal Data' dated July 2, 2019, and other applicable laws, establishing the procedures for collection, systematization, storage, processing, and protection of users' personal data on the 'Zehin' platform. By registering or using the Platform, the User voluntarily consents to these terms. Administration: self-employed individual under the 'Birlik' brand (TIN: 200836354). Official contact: Telegram — https://t.me/zehinuz?direct.
privacyPage.p2: The Administration collects only the minimum amount of data required to render services. During the use of the Platform, the following data is processed:
p2List: Ro'yxatdan o'tish ma'lumotlari: ism (Foydalanuvchi ko'rsatgan shaklda), mobil telefon raqami va hisob paroli;
Hisob paroli: parol xavfsizlik maqsadida faqat shifrlangan (xeshlangan) ko'rinishda saqlanadi va hech kimga ochiq holda ma'lum bo'lmaydi;
Profileda ixtiyoriy to'ldiriladigan ma'lumotlar: o'qitiladigan fan (yo'nalish), joriy pedagogik toifa, jins, tug'ilgan sana hamda tayyor to'plamdan tanlangan avatar;
O'quv faoliyati: yechilgan testlar tarixi, xato javoblar statistikasi, to'plangan ballar (XP), seriyalar va reyting ko'rsatkichlari;

To'lov ma'lumotlari: tanlangan tarif, to'lov sanasi, summasi va holati. Diqqat: bank kartasi raqamlari va boshqa to'lov rekvizitlari Platformada saqlanmaydi — ular faqat tegishli to'lov tizimining o'zida qayta ishlanadi;
Referral (taklif) dasturi ma'lumotlari: taklif havolasi orqali ro'yxatdan o'tgan foydalanuvchilar soni va ismlari;
Texnik ma'lumotlar: IP-manzil, qurilma va brauzer turi haqidagi standart server yozuvlari (loglar) — faqat xavfsizlikni ta'minlash, xatoliklarni aniqlash va suiiste'mollardan himoya qilish maqsadida;
Brauzer xotirasi (localStorage/cookie): kirish sessiyasi, tanlangan til, mavzu (tungi/kunduzgi rejim) va shunga o'xshash texnik sozlamalar Foydalanuvchining o'z qurilmasida saqlanadi.
privacyPage.p3: Personal data is processed exclusively for the following specified and lawful purposes:
p3List: Foydalanuvchini identifikatsiya qilish, hisobga kirishni telefon raqami va parol orqali tasdiqlash va ruxsatsiz kirishlarning oldini olish;
O'quv jarayonini shaxsiylashtirish: tanlangan fan va tayyorgarlik darajasiga mos testlar, takrorlash rejalari va statistikani shakllantirish;
Pro Subscriptionni rasmiylashtirish, to'lovlarni hisobga olish va obuna holati haqida xabardor qilish;
Referral dasturining to'g'ri ishlashini ta'minlash va chegirma/bonuslarni hisoblash;
Ommaviy reytingda (Leaderboard) Foydalanuvchi faolligini aks ettirish;
Platforma barqarorligini tahlil qilish, xatoliklarni bartaraf etish va xizmat sifatini yaxshilash (agregatsiyalangan, shaxssizlantirilgan statistika asosida).
privacyPage.p4: The Administration does not sell, rent, or trade personal data to third parties for commercial purposes. Minimal data required for service provision may be transferred only to trusted technology partners (processors):
p4List: Google Firebase (Google LLC) — autentifikatsiya, ma'lumotlar bazasi va hostingni ta'minlovchi bulut infratuzilmasi; ma'lumotlar himoyalangan serverlarda shifrlangan holda saqlanadi;
Google Analytics — Platformadan foydalanish bo'yicha shaxssizlantirilgan statistika (sahifa ko'rishlari, umumiy faollik) to'plash uchun;
To'lov tizimlari (Click va Platformada ko'rsatilgan boshqa usullar) — to'lovlarni qayta ishlash uchun zarur bo'lgan minimal hajmda;
Davlat organlari — faqat O'zbekiston Respublikasi qonunchiligida belgilangan tartibda sud yoki vakolatli organning rasmiy va qonuniy so'roviga asosan.
privacyPage.p5: In the public Leaderboard section of the Platform, only your name, selected avatar, and learning scores (points, level) are visible to other users — your phone number and contact details are never disclosed. The name of a user registered via your referral link may be visible to you, and your name may be visible to the user who invited you.
privacyPage.h6: 6. Data Retention Period and Right to Erasure
privacyPage.p6a: Personal data is retained for as long as your account remains active. The User has the right to modify their data or request total account deletion at any time via the
privacyPage.p6b: section on the Platform or by submitting a request through the
privacyPage.p6c: without logging in. Upon account deletion, profile data and statistics are immediately erased, and backup data is permanently destroyed within 30 calendar days. Payment transaction logs may be retained as required by financial auditing regulations.
privacyPage.p7: Data is transmitted via HTTPS (TLS) encrypted protocols between device and server, database access is strictly governed by Firebase Security Rules, passwords are stored using secure hash functions, and login attempts are rate-limited. Users are required to safeguard access to their phone number and device, and never share their account password with anyone — including individuals identifying as Administration staff. The Administration will never ask for your password.
privacyPage.p8: In accordance with Law ZRU-547, Users have the following rights:
p8List: O'zi haqida qanday ma'lumotlar qayta ishlanayotgani to'g'risida ma'lumot olish;
Noto'g'ri yoki eskirgan ma'lumotlarni tuzatish va yangilashni talab qilish;
Shaxsiy ma'lumotlarini qayta ishlashga bergan rozilikni qaytarib olish va hisobni o'chirishni talab qilish;
Huquqlari buzilgan deb hisoblasa, Ma'muriyatga yoki vakolatli davlat organiga murojaat qilish.
privacyPage.p9: The Administration reserves the right to amend this Policy due to legal updates or service enhancements. New revisions become effective upon publication on the Platform, indicated by the 'Effective Date' at the top of the page. Continued use of the Platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

termsPage.h1: 1. Legal Status of Agreement and Parties
termsPage.p1: This document constitutes an official public offer in accordance with Articles 367, 369, and 370 of the Civil Code of the Republic of Uzbekistan. Registering, using, or making payments on the 'Zehin' platform (hereinafter 'Platform') signifies full understanding and unconditional acceptance (acceptance) of these terms by the individual (hereinafter 'User'), holding equal legal force to a signed paper agreement. The Platform is designed for self-preparation of pedagogical staff for qualification exams. Services are provided by an registered self-employed individual under the 'Birlik' brand (hereinafter 'Administration'). Official contact channel: Telegram — https://t.me/zehinuz?direct.
termsPage.p2: Access to the Platform is based on phone number and password authentication. The User agrees to:
p2List: Ro'yxatdan o'tishda faqat o'ziga tegishli telefon raqamini ko'rsatish — hisob shu raqamga biriktiriladi va raqam egasi hisobdagi barcha harakatlar uchun mas'ul hisoblanadi;
Hisob parolini uchinchi shaxslarga (jumladan, hamkasblar va yaqinlarga ham) bermaslik;
Bitta hisobdan faqat shaxsan o'zi foydalanish — hisobni bir vaqtning o'zida bir nechta shaxs yoki qurilma tomonidan ommaviy ishlatish taqiqlanadi;
Telefon raqami boshqa shaxsga o'tgan yoki hisobga ruxsatsiz kirish gumon qilingan taqdirda darhol Ma'muriyatga xabar berish.
termsPage.p3: Within the framework of fair use of the Platform, Users are strictly prohibited from:
p3List: Ro'yxatdan o'tishda va profilda o'zi haqida ataylab noto'g'ri ma'lumot taqdim etish;
Savollar bazasini botlar, skriptlar yoki skreyper/parser dasturlari yordamida ommaviy ko'chirib olish, tizimga xakerlik hujumi uyushtirish yoki zaifliklardan foydalanishga urinish;
Platforma materiallarini (savollar, izohlar, skrinshot/skrinkastlar) pullik yoki ommaviy guruhlarda, ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda va boshqa resurslarda Ma'muriyatning yozma ruxsatisiz tarqatish;
Leaderboard tizimida yoki qo'llab-quvvatlash xizmati bilan muloqotda haqoratli so'zlar ishlatish, boshqa foydalanuvchilar yoki Ma'muriyat sha'niga putur yetkazish;
Referral dasturi va promo-kodlarni soxta hisoblar ochish yo'li bilan suiiste'mol qilish.
termsPage.h4: 4. Scope of Services: Free Mode, Trial Period, and Pro Subscription
termsPage.p4: Platform services are offered under the following modes:
p4List: Bepul sinov davri (Trial): yangi ro'yxatdan o'tgan Foydalanuvchiga Platforma imkoniyatlari bilan tanishish uchun cheklangan muddatga to'liq kirish berilishi mumkin; aniq muddati va shartlari Platformada ko'rsatiladi;
Bepul rejim: sinov davri tugagach, Foydalanuvchi kunlik cheklovlar doirasida asosiy funksiyalardan bepul foydalanishda davom etadi;

Pro Subscription: tanlangan muddatga (masalan, 1, 3 yoki 12 oy) barcha mavzular, imtihon simulyatori, aqlli takrorlash va batafsil statistikaga to'liq kirishni ochadi. Obuna to'lov tasdiqlangan paytdan kuchga kiradi va belgilangan muddat tugagunga qadar amal qiladi. Amaldagi obuna ustiga yangi to'lov qilinsa, qolgan kunlar yo'qolmaydi — muddat ustiga qo'shiladi;
Obuna avtomatik uzaytirilmaydi: muddat tugaganda hech qanday mablag' avtomatik yechib olinmaydi — Foydalanuvchi o'z xohishiga ko'ra qayta to'lov qiladi, aks holda hisob bepul rejimga qaytadi;
Narxlar: amaldagi tariflar va narxlar Platformaning «Pro» bo'limida ko'rsatiladi. Ma'muriyat narxlarni o'zgartirish huquqiga ega, biroq o'zgarish avval to'lab qo'yilgan davrga ta'sir qilmaydi.
termsPage.p5: Payments are conducted in Uzbek Som (UZS) via the payment methods indicated on the Platform:
p5List: To'lov usullari: rasmiy Telegram operatori (https://t.me/zehinuz?direct) orqali, shuningdek Platformaga ulangan to'lov tizimlari (Click va boshqalar — joriy mavjud usullar ilovaning to'lov oynasida ko'rsatiladi) orqali;

Activelashtirish: to'lov tasdiqlangach, Pro Subscription Foydalanuvchi profiliga biriktiriladi. Operator orqali to'lovda faollashtirish qisqa muddat (odatda bir necha daqiqadan bir necha soatgacha) talab qilishi mumkin;

Qaytarish siyosati: Zehin raqamli ta'lim xizmati bo'lgani uchun obuna faollashtirilgach, xizmat ko'rsatilgan hisoblanadi va to'langan mablag' qaytarilmaydi. Istisno: to'lov qabul qilinib, texnik nosozlik tufayli xizmat umuman faollashmagan holatlar — bunda Ma'muriyat muammoni bartaraf etadi yoki mablag'ni to'liq qaytaradi. Bunday holatda https://t.me/zehinuz?direct orqali murojaat qilish lozim.
termsPage.p6: Referral invitation programs and promotional codes may be active on the Platform. Specific terms regarding discounts, bonus days, and rewards are published in corresponding sections. The Administration reserves the right to modify terms or cancel rewards in case of fraudulent activity or abuse. Referral bonuses are non-redeemable for cash.
termsPage.p7: All materials on the Platform — question database, explanations, methodological notes, software code, UI design, and branding elements — are intellectual property of the 'Zehin' project and protected by copyright laws. Materials may only be used for personal preparation. Unauthorized distribution or copying will result in account termination without refund and legal prosecution.
termsPage.p8: The Platform is an independent educational preparatory tool and is not an official government agency or official exam provider. Questions are independently authored learning materials. The Administration does not guarantee passing government qualification exams solely through platform usage — final results depend on individual preparation and effort.
termsPage.p9: Disputes between parties shall first be resolved through good-faith negotiation via https://t.me/zehinuz?direct. If unresolved, disputes will be submitted to jurisdiction under Uzbek law. Continued use of the Platform after updates constitutes agreement to updated terms.
